question.prompt: Buffalo Shuffle-o is a card game in which all the cards are distributed evenly among all players at the start of the game. When Annika and \(3\) of her friends play Buffalo Shuffle-o, each player is dealt \(15\) cards. Suppose \(2\) more friends join the next game. How many cards will be dealt to each player?

solutions.explanation:
Annika and her \(3\) friends make \(4\) players, so the total number of cards is
\[
4\times15=60.
\]
With \(2\) more friends, there are \(4+2=6\) players. Sharing the same \(60\) cards evenly gives
\[
60\div6=10
\]
cards per player, with none left over. The answer is \(\boxed{10}\), choice \(\text{C}\).
solutions.title: Find the deck size and divide
